title: Aesthetica+
description: Transforming the visuals of Minecraft whilst adding stuff to help you through your journey.
body:
Aesthetica+ is a Vanilla+ modpack that transforms the visuals of Minecraft by adding better visuals, sounds, and more blocks like furniture.

Aesthetica contains mods such as:

*   Cool Rain
*   Euphoria Patches
*   Handcrafted
*   Simple Animated Guns (To help with those pesky mobs)
*   Advancement Plaques
*   Distant Horizons
*   And more!

Create your own machines with Create. Go on adventures with Distant Horizons. Pave your own way to your perfect world!

Check it out! :3

[JOIN OUT DISCORD BY CLICKING HERE!](https://discord.gg/9bbCuNYwnf)
